title: Kicked Cheesy Filipino Cheddar Fritters
description: Malty, bouncy-qq double-fried fritters packed with mature cheddar and a dairy‑free binder, perfect for a post‑workout boost.
instructions: Whisk oat milk, flaxseed, and protein powder until thick and let sit for 5 minutes to form a flax egg.
In a large bowl, sift together flour, cornstarch, malted barley flour, baking powder, salt, and pepper.
Pour the flax egg into the dry mix and stir until a sticky batter forms.
Fold in the shredded cheddar until evenly coated.
Heat the kadhai over medium and drizzle 1 tbsp oil to coat the surface.
Drop spoonfuls of batter into the oil and fry until golden on the first pass, about 3 minutes per side.
Reduce heat to medium-low, add a touch more oil, and continue frying each fritter for an additional 2 minutes to finish double frying.
Remove fritters with a slotted spoon and set on paper towels to drain excess oil.
Allow the fritters to rest for 1 minute before serving.
Serve hot with sweet chili dip for a satisfying post-workout snack.
